description: Defines an enumeration TOperator for various shader operators used in the ANGLE project's high-level parse tree representation, including unary, binary, built-in functions, and special operators.

methods.name: GetOperatorString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given operator in GLSL.

methods.name: IsAssignment
methods.description: Determines if a given operator is an assignment operator.

methods.name: IsAtomicFunction
methods.description: Checks if a given operator is an atomic function.
